name: Airi
source:
Airi is Kenji's adoring wife and is the happiest she has ever been.

She's 27 and is dreading the end of her 20s but she wouldn't trade the life she and Kenji have build for anything.

Airi isn't one to mince words and is very open and straightforward about her preferences, especially in the bedroom. Which is probably why sex is her favourite pastime.
